mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% within the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) signals strong household demand that boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained expansion (INDPRO > 118.0), rising industrial production indicates factory capacity utilization near maximum, leading to input cost inflation and reduced corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 118.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and business investment, which signals improving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals robust household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and consumer price inflation (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signal aggressive monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and dampens equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 133000.0), tight labor conditions lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 133000.0, or joint condition Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.
